notes.title: July 11 changes
notes.notes:
- Tape now can run out when used
- Crafting fixes & small crafting UI changes
- Fixed crash when giving Pekka his drink/talking to bouncer when playing with portuguese language
- Fixed a rare crash when joining another player's game
- Changed journal quest texts, the texts (should) no longer go over the pages' size
- Fixed Pekka only accepting cola bottles
- Temporarily disabled Jari going to the shop
- Added a new pair of shoes

notes.title: Moonshine update
notes.notes:
Moonshine update is now available

- Added the ability to create moonshine
- Fluids can now heat up and boil
- Added a new bottle, buyable from the shop
- Kilju (and moonshine) now has to be sold in bottles instead of any container
- Kilju can now be made in any container
- FPS stabilizations / optimizations
- Added 10 new achievements
- Reworked NPC system to allow faster development in the future (Pekka is still on the old system and will be updated asap)
- Reworked fluid system allowing further optimization and flexibility
- Adding/taking fluids in containers now works by holding the add/take button instead of increments
- Added ability to mow player's own grass at the cottage
- The water jug at the cottage is now functional
- Re-enabled DLSS frame generation
- Saves can now be renamed when saving
- Saves can now be deleted
- Deer and rabbit meat can now be sold to Juha
- Game will now pause in singleplayer when pause menu is open
- Player can now drown
- Added methanol poisoning
- Added controller support for character customization
- Fixed Pekka glitching when asked to play cards
- Fixed Pekka not going hunting
- Fixed pocket items not saving their state when put in pocket by client
- Fixed clients being unable to take logs from log piles
- Fixed player being able to take phone from charger when not clothed
- Fixed swimming animations
- Fixed custom graphics preset not saving correctly
- Testing a fix on the TV crashing for some people

- Fixed game crashing if trying to go to bar with Pekka while Juha is dead.
- Fixed worm rod flying away

notes.title: Bar update
notes.notes:
This was meant to be a larger update that would have included moonshine as well, but due to the difficulty and slowdowns caused by the bar in development, we decided to split the update into two parts. Moonshine will come as soon as we get it ready. We also had to update the engine version to allow for more optimized versions of characters, so we can have more of them in one place without massive lagging.

Hopefully no other update will take as long as this one did.

Changes in the list below do not contain nearly all of the changes or fixes we have made in this update, only the most relevant things.

- Added a bar
- Improved controller support (this is not complete and will be improved further in the future)
- Added support for controller rebinding.
- Removed some experimental graphics stuff, possibly allowing the game to run on older hardware.
- Added ability to put certain small items into your pocket.
- Added a small notification when the player gains/loses money.
- Updated and improved some animations.
- Increased chance of rain.
- Added voice chat. Hold V to speak in game.
- Adjusted rate of getting drunk, and water now helps decrease drunkness.
- Added some new achievements.
